title: action_upserted.v1
description: Emitted when an `actions` row is created or modified. Written same-tx with the `actions` insert/update so consumers can rebuild the seg ES doc `actions[]` nested field deterministically. See docs/review/data-platform-design.md §5.2.15.

action_id.description: Action identifier (8-char alphanumeric, primary key of `actions`).

asset_id.description: Parent seg asset identifier. MUST reference assets.asset_id with asset_type='segment'.

start_ns.description: Half-open interval start (ns relative to mcap origin, same scale as assets.start_timestamp_ns).

action_index.description: Optional human-readable ordinal inside the seg.

primary_label.description: Primary label used for facets / list display.

labels.description: Multi-label set (GIN-indexed in PG, mirrored to seg ES doc).

version.description: Optimistic-lock version of the actions row after the write.
